text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, my tempo's way faster!
At this rate, the gap's just gonna keep getting wider and wider!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, in that case, shall we get serious?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'll flatten ya!
Let's settle this fair and square, oraah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Dammit, how?!
You haven't been doing secret training, have you?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, I haven't. I just carry out the regimen my Trainer puts together every day.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The answer is obvious.
—My Trainer is simply exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even after passing the exam, Trainer keeps on studying.
For my sake. For Funabashi's sake.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my menu is evolving day by day. Tomorrow better than today, the day after better than tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That is why I carried it out with complete sincerity.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...The hell?
You bastards are all pumped the hell up, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"We carry Funabashi on our shoulders, after all.
But more than that, above all else—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my trainer work so hard for me,
of course... there's no way I wouldn't want to live up to that.
